allowed_only: Canonical definitions, domain/measure/normalization and matrix norm conventions. No proof hypotheses or proposed new proof.
meaning: The carrier is real Euclidean space with q+1 coordinates, its Euclidean norm and Borel sigma-algebra. WithLp.ofLp exposes its coordinate function.

The measure is the canonical centered variance-one standard Gaussian. Its implementation is a pushforward of independent gaussianReal 0 1 coordinates through an orthonormal basis. No law certificate is a supplied premise.
A real Matrix m n is the finite array m → n → real. Matrix.of is the canonical identity equivalence. vecMulVec w v has entry w_i v_j, so G is the uncentered rank-one second-moment matrix.
Matrix.one is diagonal with ones on the diagonal. Matrix.kronecker A B has paired indices with entry A_(i1,j1) B_(i2,j2), giving the ordered gamma-index first and deterministic feature-index second.

The scoped matrix norm is the Euclidean L2 operator norm transported through matrices as continuous linear maps. Its topology agrees with the existing product topology. All matrix integrals use this declared scope.

Set.indicator returns the indicated function on its set and zero elsewhere. The kept event includes equality R=L. The scalar a is the unnormalized retained radial moment divided by r, with no division by a retention probability.

Integrable means a.e. strong measurability and finite norm integral. The real and matrix integrals are Bochner integrals. Their totalized nonintegrable branch returns zero. Both matrix integrabilities are target conclusions, and the finite-dimensional complete matrix codomain is canonical.

All finite natural casts, positive row dimension q+1, source dimension/denominator facts, Gaussian invariance and integrability obligations must be established internally. The consumer fixes a literal deterministic midpoint cosine row, not an assumed bounded feature vector.

irreducible_def integral {_ : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : Measure α) (f : α → G) : G :=
  if _ : CompleteSpace G then
    if hf : Integrable f μ then L1.integral (hf.toL1 f) else 0
  else 0

def ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian.{u_2} : (E : Type u_2) →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] → [inst : MeasurableSpace E] → Measure E :=
fun E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] =>
  Measure.map (fun x => ∑ i, x i • (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E) i) (Measure.pi fun x => gaussianReal 0 1)
@[reducible] def EuclideanSpace.{u_7, u_8} : Type u_7 → Type u_8 → Type (max u_7 u_8) :=
fun 𝕜 n => PiLp 2 fun x => 𝕜
@[reducible] def WithLp.ofLp.{u_1} : {p : ENNReal} → {V : Type u_1} → WithLp p V → V :=
fun p V self => self.1
def Matrix.vecMulVec.{v, u_2, u_3} : {m : Type u_2} →
  {n : Type u_3} → {α : Type v} → [Mul α] → (m → α) → (n → α) → Matrix m n α :=
fun {m} {n} {α} [Mul α] w v => Matrix.of fun x y => w x * v y
def Matrix.kronecker.{u_3, u_9, u_10, u_11, u_12} : {α : Type u_3} →
  {l : Type u_9} →
    {m : Type u_10} →
      {n : Type u_11} → {p : Type u_12} → [Mul α] → Matrix l m α → Matrix n p α → Matrix (l × n) (m × p) α :=
fun {α} {l} {m} {n} {p} [Mul α] => Matrix.kroneckerMap fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2
def Set.indicator.{u_1, u_3} : {α : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_3} → [Zero M] → Set α → (α → M) → α → M :=
fun {α} {M} [Zero M] s f x => if x ∈ s then f x else 0
def MeasureTheory.Integrable.{u_5, u_8} : {ε : Type u_5} →
  [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] →
    [ContinuousENorm ε] →
      {α : Type u_8} → {x : MeasurableSpace α} → (α → ε) → autoParam (Measure α) Integrable._auto_1 → Prop :=
fun {ε} [TopologicalSpace ε] [ContinuousENorm ε] {α} {x} f μ => AEStronglyMeasurable f μ ∧ HasFiniteIntegral f μ
@[irreducible] def MeasureTheory.integral.{u_6, u_7} : {α : Type u_6} →
  {G : Type u_7} →
    [inst : NormedAddCommGroup G] → [NormedSpace ℝ G] → {x : MeasurableSpace α} → Measure α → (α → G) → G :=
wrapped✝.1
@[instance_reducible] def Matrix.instL2OpNormedAddCommGroup.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {𝕜 : Type u_1} →
  {m : Type u_2} →
    {n : Type u_3} → [RCLike 𝕜] → [Fintype m] → [Fintype n] → [DecidableEq n] → NormedAddCommGroup (Matrix m n 𝕜) :=
fun {𝕜} {m} {n} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] =>
  { toNorm := Matrix.l2OpNormedAddCommGroupAux.toNorm, toAddCommGroup := Matrix.addCommGroup,
    toMetricSpace := Matrix.instL2OpMetricSpace, dist_eq := ⋯ }
@[instance_reducible] def Matrix.l2OpNormedAddCommGroupAux.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {𝕜 : Type u_1} →
  {m : Type u_2} →
    {n : Type u_3} → [RCLike 𝕜] → [Fintype m] → [Fintype n] → [DecidableEq n] → NormedAddCommGroup (Matrix m n 𝕜) :=
fun {𝕜} {m} {n} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] =>
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced (Matrix m n 𝕜) (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n →L[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 m)
    (Matrix.toEuclideanLin.trans LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap) ⋯
def Matrix.toEuclideanCLM.{u_1, u_3} : {𝕜 : Type u_1} →
  {n : Type u_3} →
    [inst : RCLike 𝕜] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype n] → [DecidableEq n] → Matrix n n 𝕜 ≃⋆ₐ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n →L[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 n :=
fun {𝕜} {n} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] =>
  (LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜)).symm.trans
    (let __src := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap;
    { toFun := (↑__src).toFun, invFun := __src.invFun, left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯,
      map_star' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯ })
def Matrix.{u, u', v} : Type u → Type u' → Type v → Type (max u u' v) :=
fun m n α => m → n → α
def Matrix.of.{v, u_2, u_3} : {m : Type u_2} → {n : Type u_3} → {α : Type v} → (m → n → α) ≃ Matrix m n α :=
fun {m} {n} {α} => Equiv.refl (m → n → α)
@[instance_reducible] def Matrix.one.{v, u_3} : {n : Type u_3} →
  {α : Type v} → [DecidableEq n] → [Zero α] → [One α] → One (Matrix n n α) :=
fun {n} {α} [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] [One α] => { one := Matrix.diagonal fun x => 1 }
def Matrix.diagonal.{v, u_3} : {n : Type u_3} → {α : Type v} → [DecidableEq n] → [Zero α] → (n → α) → Matrix n n α :=
fun {n} {α} [DecidableEq n] [Zero α] d => Matrix.of fun i j => if i = j then d i else 0
@[instance_reducible] def Matrix.instL2OpNormedSpace.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {𝕜 : Type u_1} →
  {m : Type u_2} →
    {n : Type u_3} →
      [inst : RCLike 𝕜] →
        [inst_1 : Fintype m] → [inst_2 : Fintype n] → [inst_3 : DecidableEq n] → NormedSpace 𝕜 (Matrix m n 𝕜) :=
fun {𝕜} {m} {n} [RCLike 𝕜] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] => { toModule := Matrix.module, norm_smul_le := ⋯ }
